result.instructions: Polterware MCP: four tools. polter.query reads compact text: "brief <slug|path|file>" before you work on a card, node, or file (tasks, invariants, the Rules that bind it, milestone); "search <terms>" finds anything; "show <id>" opens one record; also "commits <slug>", "status", "inbox", "cards", "handoff <slug>", "structure [<path>]", "rules [status]", "milestones", "roadmap", and "canvas [<name|id>]" (agent-visible canvases only). polter.apply writes Work cards, Structure nodes, and Rules as Polter text with summary and rationale, and a canvas from Mermaid source (canvas: <name|id>; "canvas" is a polter.format topic). doc.upsert writes a doc with a Markdown body. Writes join this session's run; there is nothing to start or complete.
